GA4 Behavioral Segmentation of Google Merchandise Store Users
DATASET — GA4 (bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce) · 270,154 users · k-means clustering (k=4)
METHOD NOTE — k=4 chosen over the algorithmically preferred k=2 for interpretability; documented, defended design decision.
Sub-segmentation of the Browser cluster is a descriptive, rule-based heuristic, not a validated typology.
